title: Launch social media services marketplace with admin dashboard

requirements.text: Create a homepage in Arabic (RTL layout) with branding for IBAZEX social media services marketplace, showcasing the value proposition of selling followers, likes, and views for social media platforms
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage displays Arabic text with proper RTL layout
Clear branding and tagline explaining the social media services
Professional and welcoming design

requirements.text: Build a services page displaying available social media services (followers, likes, views) for different platforms (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok) in a simple table format with service name, price, and description columns
acceptanceCriteria: Services displayed in a clean, easy-to-read table
Each row shows service name, price, and description
Table includes services for followers, likes, and views
Supports multiple social media platforms

requirements.text: Implement backend data model and API endpoints for services with fields including platform (Facebook/Instagram/YouTube/TikTok), service type (followers/likes/views), price, description, and availability status
acceptanceCriteria: Services stored with platform, type, price, description fields
API endpoints to fetch all services
API endpoints to add, update, and delete services
Services can be marked as available or unavailable

requirements.text: Create an admin dashboard with authentication that allows editing service prices, adding new services, and managing service availability
acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel requires authentication to access
Interface to view all services in a manageable format
Ability to edit prices for existing services
Ability to add new services with all required fields
Ability to toggle service availability on/off

requirements.text: Implement customer order system allowing users to place orders for services with fields for customer details (name, contact), selected service, quantity, and any additional information
acceptanceCriteria: Order form collects customer name and contact information
Users can select service and specify quantity
Orders stored in backend with status tracking
Admin can view all orders in dashboard

requirements.text: Integrate Internet Identity authentication system for secure user and admin access
acceptanceCriteria: Users can authenticate using Internet Identity
Authentication state persisted across sessions
Protected routes require authentication
Admin features restricted to authenticated admin users

requirements.text: Apply a creative, modern, and professional visual design theme with a distinct style that reflects the digital marketing and social media industry, using a cohesive color palette, typography, and layout patterns consistently throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: Consistent color scheme used across all pages
Professional typography suitable for Arabic text
Modern layout with appropriate spacing and visual hierarchy
Design reflects digital marketing industry aesthetic

constraints: All user-facing text must be in Arabic with RTL layout support
Use Internet Identity for authentication (no custom password systems)
Backend must use single-actor Motoko architecture
nonGoals: Integration with actual social media platform APIs
